BRA.shortDefinition: An item of clothing, usually underwear worn to support the breasts.
localDetailedDefinitions: Synonymous with BRI (Basic Rate Interface).The term BRA generally is used outside North America. See BRI.
(noun) an undergarment worn by women to support the breasts or give a desired contour to the bust

ASS.shortDefinition: Any of several species of horse-like animals, especially Equus asinus, the domesticated of which are used as beasts of burden.
localDetailedDefinitions: (noun) Any of several hoofed mammals of the genus Equus, resembling and closely related to the horses but having a smaller build and longer ears, and including the domesticated donkey.
(adjective) Used in combination with adjectives as an intensive:
(affix) added to adjectives as an intensifier

SEX.shortDefinition: A category into which sexually-reproducing organisms are divided on the basis of their reproductive roles in their species; the system of such categories, which can differ by organism or by taxonomic branch.

NUDE.shortDefinition: Without clothing or other covering of the skin; without clothing on the genitals or female nipples.

BREAST.shortDefinition: Either of the two organs on the front of a female human's chest, which contain the mammary glands; also the analogous organs in males.

RAPE.shortDefinition: The act of forcing sex upon another person without their consent or against their will; originally coitus forced by a man on a woman, but now generally any sex act forced by any person upon another person; by extension, any non-consensual sex act forced on or perpetrated by any being.

GOOSE.shortDefinition: Any of various grazing waterfowl of the family Anatidae, which have feathers and webbed feet and are capable of flying, swimming, and walking on land, and which are bigger than ducks.

PRIVATE.shortDefinition: Belonging or pertaining to an individual person, group of people, or entity that is not the state.

DELL.shortDefinition: A valley or sunken area of ground, especially in the form of a natural hollow, small and deep.

WINE.shortDefinition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

BET.shortDefinition: A wager, an agreement between two parties that a stake (usually money) will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event).

DEAD.shortDefinition: No longer living; deceased. (Also used as a noun.

HOT.shortDefinition: Relating to heat and conditions which produce it.
localDetailedDefinitions: (noun) Strong sexual attraction or desire. Used with the.
(adjective) Being at or exhibiting a temperature that is higher than normal or desirable:

HOTS.shortDefinition: A condition of physical attraction toward (for
localDetailedDefinitions: (noun) (slang) to have the 'hots' for someone means to be physically attracted to them

EROS.shortDefinition: A winged figure of a child representing love or its power.
localDetailedDefinitions: (noun) A winged figure of a child representing love and/or its power
(noun) a type of love that seeks fulfillment without violation or something else

definitionWordingScreen.note: Keyword matches are review candidates, not a list of prohibited words. Medical, biological, and neutral orientation definitions are included by the mechanical scan.

method: Read ZIP entries from the supplied APK without installing or executing it.
Decode Unity bundles with UnityPy 1.25.4, using the actual Unity 6000.3.16f1 version from data.unity3d.
Decode English level payloads with the packaged XOR format; read all records, verify word and ID fields, and consume the complete file including its footer.
Decode HardDefine at character level, preserving Unicode; do not XOR UTF-8 bytes as if they were characters.
Count a word once per level per role. Keep main variants and daily variants separate; do not add duplicate or replacement configurations to a single player frequency.
Read compressed metadata declarations using token and owner checks; metadata contains declarations, not executable method bodies.
